claim: End-affect pair averages are available for 1,603 of the 1,656 conversation rows, leaving 53 missing.
Pair-average affect is 6.10 before the conversation, 6.16 at the beginning, 6.93 at the midpoint and 7.38 at the end.
Among 3,257 person-records with both ratings, end affect averages 1.29 points above pre-conversation affect and the median gain is 1.00 point.
End affect rises for 2,254 person-records (69.20%), is unchanged for 668 (20.51%) and falls for 335 (10.29%).
Pair-average arousal rises from 5.32 before the conversation to 5.67 at the beginning, 6.40 at the midpoint and 6.70 at the end.
The mean absolute within-pair affect gap narrows from 1.67 before and 1.65 at the beginning to 1.35 at the midpoint and 1.31 at the end.
